subtopics.label: Amyloid-β and Tau Pathology in Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Research investigating the molecular mechanisms of amyloid-β production, aggregation, and clearance, tau phosphorylation, post-translational modifications, fibril formation, and the interplay between amyloid and tau pathologies in Alzheimer's disease and related tauopathies.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of amyloid-β aggregation, tau phosphorylation, and their interplay in Alzheimer's disease and tauopathies.

subtopics.label: Neuroinflammation and Microglial Biology in Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Studies examining microglial activation, TREM2 signaling, NF-κB pathways, progranulin deficiency, cannabinoid receptor modulation, and neuroinflammatory mechanisms including cGAS-STING and cytokine signaling in Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and ALS.
subtopics.short_description: Microglial activation, TREM2 signaling, and neuroinflammatory pathways in Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS.

subtopics.label: Alpha-Synuclein Biology and LRRK2 Mechanisms in Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Research on alpha-synuclein aggregation, membrane interactions, vesicle trafficking, lysosomal exocytosis, and the structural biology and kinase activity of LRRK1/LRRK2 including microtubule interactions and inhibitor development relevant to Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Alpha-synuclein aggregation, vesicle trafficking, and LRRK2 kinase biology relevant to Parkinson's disease therapeutics.

subtopics.label: Blood-Brain Barrier Dysfunction and Neurovascular Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Studies on blood-brain barrier permeability, neurovascular coupling, tPA and plasminogen activator pathways, border-associated macrophages, cerebral amyloid angiopathy, and endothelial dysfunction in aging and neurodegenerative diseases including Alzheimer's disease.
subtopics.short_description: BBB permeability, neurovascular coupling, and endothelial dysfunction in aging and neurodegenerative diseases.

subtopics.label: Glymphatic System, CSF Clearance, and Brain Fluid Dynamics
subtopics.description: Research on glymphatic clearance pathways, perivascular space dynamics, CSF flow, interstitial fluid transport, and their associations with amyloid-β deposition, tau accumulation, and neurodegeneration measured via DTI-ALPS, MRI, and PET imaging.
subtopics.short_description: Perivascular clearance pathways, CSF flow dynamics, and their links to amyloid and tau accumulation.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging Biomarkers and Quantitative MRI/PET Methods
subtopics.description: Development and application of quantitative neuroimaging techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping, arterial spin labeling, amyloid and tau PET, FDG-PET statistical parametric mapping, and brain oxygen metabolism mapping for diagnosing and monitoring neurodegenerative diseases.
subtopics.short_description: Advanced neuroimaging techniques including amyloid/tau PET and quantitative MRI for diagnosing and monitoring neurodegeneration.

subtopics.label: Corneal Confocal Microscopy as Biomarker in Neurodegeneration and Multiple Sclerosis
subtopics.description: Studies using corneal confocal microscopy and retinal nerve fiber analysis to detect and monitor neurodegeneration in multiple sclerosis, mild cognitive impairment, dementia, and Parkinson's disease, establishing corneal nerve loss as a peripheral biomarker of central neurodegeneration.
subtopics.short_description: Corneal nerve loss as a peripheral biomarker of central neurodegeneration in MS, dementia, and Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: AAV Gene Therapy for Neurodegeneration including Batten Disease and Alzheimer's
subtopics.description: Research on adeno-associated virus (AAV)-mediated gene therapy for neurological diseases including CLN2 Batten disease, metachromatic leukodystrophy, Friedreich's ataxia, and Alzheimer's disease, covering vector design, safety, biodistribution, and long-term clinical outcomes.
subtopics.display_name: AAV Gene Therapy for Neurological Disease
subtopics.short_description: AAV-mediated gene therapy for Batten disease, leukodystrophy, Friedreich's ataxia, and Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Computational Drug Repurposing and Knowledge Graph Approaches for Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Application of machine learning, knowledge graphs, biomedical knowledge hubs, and multi-omic frameworks to identify and validate drug repurposing candidates for Alzheimer's disease, Parkinson's disease, and ALS, including target trial emulation with real-world data.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and knowledge graph frameworks to identify repurposed drug candidates for Alzheimer's, Parkinson's, and ALS.

subtopics.label: Metabolic Dysregulation and Bioenergetics in Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic alterations in Alzheimer's disease including lipid dysregulation, mitochondrial succinylation, ketogenic and Mediterranean diets, triglyceride metabolism, bioenergetic capacity, and metabolomic profiling of brain and serum in AD and MCI.
subtopics.short_description: Lipid dysregulation, mitochondrial metabolism, and dietary interventions in Alzheimer's disease and mild cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: Parkinson's Disease Clinical Management: Dysphagia, Sleep, and DBS
subtopics.description: Clinical research on Parkinson's disease management including respiratory-swallow coordination, dysphagia assessment, cough testing, deep brain stimulation timing and programming practices, sleep disturbances, and light therapy interventions.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical management of dysphagia, sleep disturbances, and deep brain stimulation programming in Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: ALS, TDP-43 Pathology, and Frontotemporal Dementia Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research on molecular mechanisms of ALS and frontotemporal dementia including TDP-43 dysregulation in astrocytes, SOD1 toxicity, transsulfuration pathway alterations, CHCHD10/CHCHD2 amyloid fibrils, and splicing dysregulation in FTD brain tissue.
subtopics.short_description: Molecular mechanisms of TDP-43 dysregulation, SOD1 toxicity, and splicing defects in ALS and frontotemporal dementia.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning Subtyping and Progression Modeling in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Data-driven studies using machine learning, clustering, and electronic health records to identify disease subphenotypes, model progression trajectories, and predict cognitive decline in Alzheimer's disease and Parkinson's disease cohorts.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning and clustering approaches to identify subphenotypes and model cognitive decline trajectories in dementia.

subtopics.label: Dementia Caregiving, Palliative Care, and Psychosocial Interventions
subtopics.description: Research on psychosocial factors, caregiver burden, self-efficacy, palliative care needs, pain assessment, and technology-based interventions supporting individuals with dementia and their caregivers in community and clinical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Caregiver burden, psychosocial interventions, and palliative care needs for individuals living with dementia.

subtopics.label: Systemic and Vascular Risk Factors for Cognitive Decline and Dementia
subtopics.description: Epidemiological and clinical studies examining associations between systemic conditions—including liver fibrosis, cardiovascular disease, hypertension, intracranial hemorrhage, and metabolic syndrome—and the risk or progression of dementia and cognitive decline.
subtopics.display_name: Systemic & Vascular Risk Factors for Dementia
subtopics.short_description: Associations between cardiovascular disease, metabolic syndrome, and liver fibrosis with dementia risk and cognitive decline.

subtopics.label: HIV-Associated Neurocognitive Impairment and Brain Pathology
subtopics.description: Research on HIV-related cognitive dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and brain abnormalities including roles of anti-CD4 IgG, extracellular vesicles, cell-free mitochondrial DNA, Galectin-9, and cellular rejuvenation strategies in treated older adults with HIV.
subtopics.short_description: Cognitive dysfunction, neuroinflammation, and brain pathology linked to HIV infection in treated older adults.

subtopics.label: Computerized Cognitive and Functional Skills Training in Mild Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating computerized cognitive training and functional skills training programs in older adults with and without mild cognitive impairment, including predictors of mastery, performance-based outcomes, and awareness of deficits.
subtopics.display_name: Cognitive Training in Mild Cognitive Impairment
subtopics.short_description: Computerized cognitive and functional skills training programs for older adults with mild cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: Mitochondrial Complex I Function and Mitochondrial Disease Mechanisms
subtopics.description: Research quantifying mitochondrial complex I content and investigating mitochondrial disease manifestations in relation to transcriptome location, including multi-omic analyses of cardiac mitochondrial stress in frataxin deficiency models.
subtopics.short_description: Mitochondrial complex I function, multi-omic analyses, and cardiac mitochondrial stress in frataxin deficiency models.

subtopics.label: Niemann-Pick Type C Disease: Cholesterol Storage and Pharmacological Interventions
subtopics.description: Studies on Niemann-Pick type C1 disease mechanisms and therapeutic strategies, including HSP90 inhibitors reducing cholesterol storage in NPC1 mutant fibroblasts and pharmacological chaperone effects of itraconazole and posaconazole after washout.
subtopics.short_description: HSP90 inhibitors, pharmacological chaperones, and cholesterol storage mechanisms in Niemann-Pick type C1 disease.

subtopics.label: Choroid Plexus Pathology and Calcification in Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Research examining choroid plexus volume, calcification, and their associations with cortical microglial activation, APOE ε4 status, and neurodegeneration biomarkers using multimodal PET, CT, and MRI approaches.
subtopics.short_description: Choroid plexus volume and calcification linked to microglial activation and neurodegeneration biomarkers via multimodal imaging.

subtopics.label: Depression, Brain Aging, and Cognitive Decline in Older Adults
subtopics.description: Studies investigating the relationship between depressive symptoms, accelerated brain aging, and cognitive decline in older adults, including therapeutic interventions such as Problem Adaptation Therapy for comorbid depression and cognitive impairment.
subtopics.short_description: Depressive symptoms, accelerated brain aging, and therapeutic interventions for comorbid depression and cognitive impairment.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 and SARS-CoV-2 Neurological Complications
subtopics.description: Research on neurological consequences of SARS-CoV-2 infection including dopaminergic neuron senescence, outcomes of Parkinson's disease patients hospitalized with COVID-19, and implications for neurodegenerative disease progression.
subtopics.short_description: SARS-CoV-2 effects on dopaminergic neurons, Parkinson's disease outcomes, and implications for neurodegeneration progression.

subtopics.label: Peripheral Immune Dysregulation and Systemic Inflammation in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's Disease
subtopics.description: Studies linking peripheral immune cell imbalances, leukocytosis, and systemic inflammatory markers to amyloid deposition, cognitive decline, and disease progression in Alzheimer's and Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Peripheral immune imbalances and systemic inflammation linked to amyloid deposition and cognitive decline in dementia.

subtopics.label: Novel Molecular Targets and Small Molecule Therapeutics for Alzheimer's Disease
subtopics.description: Research identifying and validating novel molecular targets for Alzheimer's disease treatment, including CK1γ2 activation to reduce amyloid, adenosine deficiency driving synaptic hyperexcitability, transposable element dysregulation, and sex-specific demyelination via Tlr7.
subtopics.display_name: Novel Molecular Targets for Alzheimer's Therapy
subtopics.short_description: Identification of therapeutic targets including CK1δ/γ, adenosine pathways, and transposable element dysregulation in Alzheimer's disease.

subtopics.label: Metabolic and Synaptic Mechanisms in Parkinson's Disease Neurodegeneration
subtopics.description: Studies on metabolic deficits and synaptic biology in Parkinson's disease, including phosphoglycerate kinase as a leverage point for neuronal ATP production, alpha-synuclein modulation by beta- and gamma-synucleins, and cysteine string protein-alpha aggregation via iron-sulfur cluster binding.
subtopics.short_description: Neuronal ATP production, synuclein modulation, and synaptic protein aggregation mechanisms in Parkinson's disease.

subtopics.label: Advanced MRI Methods for Brain Tissue Characterization and Longitudinal Analysis
subtopics.description: Development and validation of advanced MRI techniques including quantitative susceptibility mapping, myelin volume fraction mapping from multi-echo gradient echo data, landmark-guided spatial normalization, and learning-based longitudinal image change inference for brain research.
subtopics.display_name: Advanced MRI Methods for Brain Characterization
subtopics.short_description: Quantitative susceptibility mapping, myelin volume fraction imaging, and longitudinal MRI analysis techniques for brain research.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell and Multi-Omic Genomics of Brain Cell Types and Disease
subtopics.description: High-resolution single-cell and multi-omic studies characterizing splicing patterns, chromatin accessibility, transcriptome diversity, and DNA damage across brain cell types in development, aging, and neurological disease states.
subtopics.short_description: High-resolution single-cell transcriptomics and chromatin profiling across brain cell types in aging and neurological disease.

subtopics.label: Traumatic Brain Injury, Tau Pathology, and CTE
subtopics.description: Research on traumatic brain injury consequences including altered brain fluid clearance measured by PET, tau PET off-target binding linked to CTE development, and axon-T cell feedback loops enhancing neuroinflammation and axon degeneration.
subtopics.short_description: TBI consequences including altered fluid clearance, tau pathology, and neuroinflammatory mechanisms linked to CTE development.

subtopics.label: Computational Transcriptomic Approaches to Brain Aging and Age-Modulating Compounds
subtopics.description: Computational frameworks leveraging transcriptional age signatures to identify age-modulating compounds in neurons and fibroblasts, and machine learning approaches for neuroimaging sub-cohort analysis and interpretability in aging and neurodegeneration research.
subtopics.short_description: Computational frameworks using transcriptional age signatures to identify age-modulating compounds and analyze neuroimaging cohorts.
